#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Append one provisioning entry to the users configuration.

set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
readonly ROOT

# shellcheck source=lib/format.sh
source "${ROOT}/lib/format.sh"

name=''
login_shell='/bin/bash'
out="${ROOT}/config/users.conf"

while (($# > 0)); do
  case "$1" in
    --name)
      name="${2:-}"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --shell)
      login_shell="${2:-}"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --out)
      out="${2:-}"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'unknown option: %s\n' "$1" >&2
      exit 64
      ;;
  esac
done

mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "${out}")"
format_line "${name}" "${login_shell}" >> "${out}"
printf 'wrote %s for %s\n' "${out}" "${name}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Coverage for bin/mkuser-config.sh.

set -uo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
readonly ROOT

work="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "${work}"' EXIT

out="${work}/users.conf"

stderr="$("${ROOT}/bin/mkuser-config.sh" --name '' --out "${out}" 2>&1 1>/dev/null)"
status=$?

if [[ ${status} -eq 0 ]]; then
  printf 'expected non-zero exit for empty --name, got 0\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ${stderr} != *'--name'*'empty'* ]]; then
  printf 'expected an empty-name error message, got: %s\n' "${stderr}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -e ${out} ]]; then
  printf 'expected no config file to be written, found %s\n' "${out}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

printf 'ok bin/mkuser-config.sh\n'
